lines.en: Leo, there are too many boxes in the hall. Where is the space?

lines.en: I know. I have too much junk, and the flat isn’t big enough.

facts.label: Quantidade e espaço
facts.sub: Too many + contável, too much + incontável, enough + substantivo ou adjetivo + enough. Too + adjetivo: too tired. Para falta, not enough.

facts.label: Demais
facts.sub: Use too many com contáveis: too many boxes. Use too much com incontáveis: too much junk, too much tape. Os dois dizem que a quantidade é maior do que o necessário e geralmente soam como problema.

facts.label: Suficiente
facts.sub: Use enough antes de substantivos: enough space, enough labels. Depois de adjetivos: big enough, warm enough. Na negativa: not enough space. A ideia é a quantidade certa.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “caixas demais”, “tralha demais” e “grande o bastante”.
compare.us: Em inglês, use too many com contáveis (too many boxes), too much com incontáveis (too much junk) e enough: enough space, big enough. Too + adjetivo: too tired.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Too many is used with countable nouns, like boxes.
Too much is used with uncountable nouns, like junk.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Too many is used with countable nouns, like boxes. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “too much boxes.” → Falso (We say too many boxes.)
Too much is used with uncountable nouns, like junk. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A flat in Leeds · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Saturday in Leeds. Leo is moving to a smaller flat. There are boxes in every room. His friend Dario comes to help. The hall is full of bags and chairs. They need a plan.

“Leo, there are too many boxes in the hall. Where is the space?” says Dario. “I know. I have too much junk, and the flat isn’t big enough.” says Leo. “Look at this one. There’s too much tape on it, and no label.” says Dario.
